name: Cone Casting
summary: A cone-shaped volume expands the effective acquisition area for remote targets.
howItWorks: Aim a cone at a region; resolve the chosen object by proximity or ranking.
advantages: Distant targets when exact ray alignment is demanding.
limitations: May create ambiguity when several candidates fall inside the cone.
